about: A family of one check as collections in the wild publish it: inform (a scan that reports), rtc (reports shortly after the create call) and prevent (deletes the new instance shortly after the create call). One bullet carrying each variant: the prevent variant deletes what was just created, which is what code creating an unencrypted instance meets; nothing blocks the call.

controls.output: - RDS instances whose `StorageEncrypted` is not true are flagged. Encrypted instances pass. HIGH, CIS; the inform policy runs on a scheduled scan and the rtc policy shortly after `CreateDBInstance`, both reporting only; the prevent policy also runs shortly after `CreateDBInstance` and deletes the new instance. acme:rds-unencrypted-inform@1, acme:rds-unencrypted-rtc@1, acme:rds-unencrypted-prevent@1

- RDS instances whose `StorageEncrypted` is not true are flagged. Encrypted instances pass. HIGH, CIS; scheduled scans and `CreateDBInstance` events report it. acme:rds-unencrypted-inform@1, acme:rds-unencrypted-rtc@1, acme:rds-unencrypted-prevent@1

- Unencrypted RDS instances cannot be created: `CreateDBInstance` is blocked, and any that slip through are deleted after the call. HIGH, CIS. acme:rds-unencrypted-inform@1, acme:rds-unencrypted-rtc@1, acme:rds-unencrypted-prevent@1

- RDS instances whose `StorageEncrypted` is not true are flagged. Encrypted instances pass. HIGH, CIS; the prevent policy deletes the new instance shortly after `CreateDBInstance`: it is removed after it is created, not blocked before. acme:rds-unencrypted-inform@1, acme:rds-unencrypted-rtc@1, acme:rds-unencrypted-prevent@1

- RDS instances whose `StorageEncrypted` is not true are flagged by a scheduled scan. Encrypted instances pass. HIGH, CIS; reports only. acme:rds-unencrypted-inform@1
- RDS instances whose `StorageEncrypted` is not true are flagged shortly after `CreateDBInstance`. Encrypted instances pass. HIGH, CIS; reports only. acme:rds-unencrypted-rtc@1
- RDS instances whose `StorageEncrypted` is not true are deleted shortly after `CreateDBInstance`. Encrypted instances pass. HIGH, CIS. acme:rds-unencrypted-prevent@1
